attack_description: Every prior attack on this claim varied only the CV grouping axis (material string, then metallurgical family, then true leave-one-family-out); none varied the ENVIRONMENT axis, even though this module's own docs/mission.md states its applicability domain is marine-coating R&D. This holds out ALL classified rows whose environment string is genuinely seawater/sea-water immersion (n=186, 2.55% of the classified cohort, 8 of 17 metallurgical families represented, all 8 also present in the non-marine training set) as a single domain-shift test set, training on the remaining 7096 non-marine classified rows with identical feature engineering, HistGBM hyperparameters, and seed=0 copied verbatim from corr-rate-family-safe-v1/corr_rate_family_safe.py and corr-rate-family-lofo-v1/corr_rate_family_lofo.py.
attacks_claim: evidence/phase0/kpis/corr-rate-family-safe-qspr-kpi.v1.dsse.json: GroupKFold(group=metallurgical_family, 5-fold) HistGBM R2=0.132087 on the NIST CORR-DATA classified subset (n=7282, 17 families), 'the module's strongest rights-clean empirical claim'; and the narrow CLAIM_SURVIVED verdict of corr-rate-family-lofo-v1 (family-weighted mean LOFO R2=0.015964).

data_integrity_finding_marine_atmospheri.description: The deployed env_features() marine flag is has('seawater','sea water','marine','atmospheric'), conflating atmospheric exposure with seawater immersion. This is a secondary finding, quantified via the patched ablation above, and does NOT itself determine the refutation verdict (which is judged on the deployed feature set, matching production behavior).

dataset.name: NIST CORR-DATA (Dow Chemical Co.) derived reference

refutation_criterion: REFUTED if (a) marine-envelope (train=all non-marine classified rows, test=all true-seawater classified rows, deployed env_features as-is) gbm.r2 <= 0.0, OR (b) marine-envelope error_reduction_vs_best_baseline_pct <= 0.0. SURVIVED otherwise, even if reduced relative to the family-safe/LOFO within-domain numbers.
scope_honesty: Diagnostic on bare metal/alloy substrate corrosion (NIST CORR-DATA), same scope ceiling as corr-rate-qspr-v1, corr-rate-family-safe-v1, and corr-rate-family-lofo-v1: NOT organic-coating barrier performance. No candidate/coating superiority claim; no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.
